purpose: Replay-speed candidate: keep color segmentation and stereo contour distance, but refresh color contour/stereo estimation only every 120 frames and reuse the cached contour ownership between refreshes.
expected_effect: Preserve cached ApproxStereoContour rough distance metadata after the first refresh frame.
Avoid running heavy color contour extraction and stereo matching on every scored replay frame.
Keep full-pixel fallback assignment through FarBackground remainder.
risk: Cached color contours can lag when the camera or objects move.
This is suitable for deterministic static replay gates before a tracked/ROI-updated live strategy is added.
If the first refresh frame has poor stereo support, later cached frames inherit that weak estimate.
